name: Adult human heart (Visium)
description: Visium section of adult human heart over its H&E: 2,913 spots under tissue (4,992 on the array) with per-spot cell-type abundances (colour spots by Metadata), from a spatial atlas of cardiac niches.

source.citation: Kanemaru K et al. (2023) Spatially resolved multiomics of human cardiac niches. Nature. doi:10.1038/s41586-023-06311-1
